items.title: BMW 1 Series (F70), country GB (market EU)
items.headline: F70 GB: the car wins on how it drives, but the touch-first cockpit is the main product problem.

items.title: BMW 5 Series Sedan (G60), market US
items.headline: US G60 customers still love the 5 Series for ride, handling and performance, but the main product issues are HMI complexity, seat comfort, and the BEV range/charging experience.

items.title: BMW 5 Series Long Wheelbase (China) (G68), market CN
items.headline: G68 China shows clear metric weaknesses in equipment perception, connected services, luggage loading, climate/NVH and braking, while brand prestige, reliability and core BMW driving character remain strengths; confidence is limited because there are no China customer comments or existing requirements in scope.

items.title: BMW 5 Series: what to change, for whom, and when
items.headline: Prioritise H1 software and regional usability fixes now, keep major EV and China-market hardware shifts for the next generation, and protect the 5 Series’ dynamic strengths.
